play.description: Play a track, album or artist from the library

params.position: Add to the end of the queue (default) or play next
Add to the end of the queue (default) or play next

playlist.description: Queue one of your Chordia playlists, or a public one

params.position: Add to the end of the queue (default) or play next

artist.description: Queue an artist's tracks, album by album

params.position: Add to the end of the queue (default) or play next

search.description: Search the library and pick what to play

remove.description: Remove a track, or a run of tracks, from the queue

params.to: The last number of a range to remove, for more than one

move.description: Move a track to another position in the queue

jump.description: Jump to a track in the queue, skipping everything before it

clear.description: Clear the queue (keeps the current track playing)

shuffle.description: Play the queue in random order, or back in order

skip.description: Skip the current track, or vote to when this server skips by vote

forceskip.description: Skip the current track at once: DJs, or server managers where there are no DJ roles

vote.description: Vote to skip the current track

back.description: Go back to the previous track

stop.description: Stop playing and clear the queue

params.position: A time like 1:23, or +30 / -30 to move relative to now

volume.description: Set the volume (100 is normal, 150 the ceiling)

loop.description: Repeat the track or the whole queue

join.description: Bring the bot into your voice channel

leave.description: Stop and leave the voice channel

eq.description: The equalizer: see it, pick a preset, set a band, or turn it on or off

params.gain: The band's gain in dB, -15 to 15

crossfade.description: Blend each track into the next over a few seconds, or not at all

params.seconds: Seconds of overlap, 0 to 12; 0 is off

radio.description: Keep the music going with similar tracks when the queue runs out

stats.description: What this server has played through the bot in the last 30 days

params.scope: Everyone's plays, or only what you asked for

lyrics.description: Lyrics for the track that is playing, from the file's tags or Chordia

bots.description: See every bot identity and which are free

skipmode.description: How a track gets skipped: by one person, or by a vote among the listeners

params.mode: Single: whoever may control playback skips at once. Vote: listeners vote
params.percent: Share of the listeners a vote needs, 1 to 100 (default 50)

pickup.description: Where the bot picks up after a restart: where it left off, or at the start of the track

params.mode: Where it left off, or the start of the track

settings.description: This server's settings for the bot

dj.description: Add or remove a DJ role (those roles may control shared playback)

params.role: A role to add, or remove if it is already a DJ role; leave empty to clear all

247.description: Keep the bot in its voice channel around the clock
